read_changes: Root rules8 and10 now refer to new mandatory rule15, replacing the advisory topic size target with a 200000000-byte maximum.
Every complete certificate, dataset or Actions output larger than5000000 bytes must be uploaded as an original natural GitHub Release asset, at most2000000000 bytes per asset.
The authorized public Release tag is data-visible-flex-exact-nearby, followed by -2 and further suffixes only after1000 assets.
Keep only asset filename, bytes, SHA256, download URL, generating source, parameters and actual run identity in repository manifests; do not artificially split or encode large data.

Existing artificial certificate parts must be reconstructed to the exact original whole file, uploaded and verified before a normal non-force main commit removes the parts; also migrate data necessary to keep this topic at or below200000000 bytes.
Public Actions uses GITHUB_TOKEN and contents:write for Release publication; root rules8 and14 still prohibit credential exposure and binary or large-content connector transfers.
The topic README and its mathematical completion criteria remain unchanged; no new numerical recomputation, freeze or approval gate is introduced.
